# SEOryon SEO ROI Calculator

> Free, browser-based calculator for the business value of SEO. Enter your
> numbers — average order value, conversion rate, margin, a revenue goal — and it
> returns the monthly organic visitors you need, what that search traffic is
> worth, and an honest SEO-agency-vs-SEOryon cost comparison with payback. No
> signup, nothing sent to a server. Built by SEOryon.

Everything runs client-side in your browser; your inputs never leave the page.
The calculator turns a revenue target into the traffic required to hit it, prices
that traffic, and shows when the investment pays back — so "what is SEO worth?"
becomes a concrete number instead of a guess.

## Docs

- [The calculator](https://roi.seoryon.com): the tool itself, with every input and assumption laid out
- [How it works](https://roi.seoryon.com/#how): the model behind the numbers, step by step
- [FAQ](https://roi.seoryon.com/#faq): what the figures mean and how to read the agency-vs-SEOryon comparison

## Related tools

- [AI Search Readiness Score](https://score.seoryon.com): score any URL 0–100 across 27 deterministic AI-search signals, with concrete fixes
- [AI Citability Grader](https://cite.seoryon.com): paste text, get a citability score for whether AI engines will quote it
- [Schema & FAQ generator](https://schema.seoryon.com): build valid JSON-LD structured data from a simple form
- [Inspect](https://inspect.seoryon.com): free Chrome extension auditing any page's on-page SEO and AI-search readiness in one click
- [SEOryon](https://seoryon.com): the company behind these tools
